name: Szentantalfa (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner tapering to a point, with a red stripe along the hoist edge and a green stripe along the fly edge, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Szentantalfa (a blue and white shield with a bunch of grapes, a church and bars) below the name SZENTANTALFA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
